description: Unit tests for SessionKey functionality in the ai.openclaw.app package.

classes.name: SessionKeyTest
classes.description: Test class for session key functions, containing test cases for building and parsing session keys.

methods.name: buildNodeMainSessionKeyUsesStableDeviceScopedSuffix
methods.description: Tests that the generated node main session key uses a stable, device-scoped suffix based on device ID and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdFromMainSessionKeyParsesCanonicalAgentKey
methods.description: Tests that the agent ID can be correctly parsed from the main session key, and null is returned for non-matching keys.
